# Vision Make Studio (VMS)

> Vision Make Studio is a digital growth studio for local businesses in New Jersey, New York and Connecticut (the tri-state area). VMS builds websites, improves local SEO and Google Maps visibility, grows Google reviews, makes branded and tracked QR codes, NFC tap-and-scan review stands and cards, LinkHub mobile link pages, and shoots real estate and restaurant photo and video. Every client gets a free business checkup reviewed by a real person.

Contact: info@visionmakestudio.com
Website: https://visionmakestudio.com/
Area served: New Jersey, New York (including New York City) and Connecticut

## Services
- [Website design and refresh](https://visionmakestudio.com/services/website-revamp): fast, mobile-first websites for local businesses with clear call, booking and order buttons.
- [New business website](https://visionmakestudio.com/services/new-business-website)
- [Local SEO and Google Business Profile](https://visionmakestudio.com/services/local-presence-setup): Google Maps profile cleanup, categories, hours, photos and consistent business details.
- [Google review growth](https://visionmakestudio.com/services/review-growth): review links, QR codes and tap cards that make it easy for happy customers to leave reviews.
- [Smart QR codes](https://visionmakestudio.com/services/smart-qr): branded QR codes; tracked codes count scans and can change destination without reprinting.
- [NFC tap and scan review stand](https://visionmakestudio.com/services/tap-scan-stand) and [review tap card](https://visionmakestudio.com/services/review-tap-card)
- [LinkHub](https://visionmakestudio.com/services/linkhub-core): a mobile link page and digital business card with call, directions, menu, Wi-Fi and booking.
- [Real estate photography](https://visionmakestudio.com/services/re-essentials): listing photos, floor plans, walkthrough video, agent tours, reels and [360 virtual tours](https://visionmakestudio.com/services/re-360-tour).
- [Restaurant photography](https://visionmakestudio.com/services/rest-photo-refresh): food, drinks, interiors and short social clips.
- [Free business checkup](https://visionmakestudio.com/services/free-business-checkup)
